# Workshopping in Stadium (BROKEN)

Source: [wiki article 7385](../archive/7385.md); edited 2025-10-08.

<a id="wiki-7385-n1"></a>

- Explicit warning: method broken as of October 1, 2025 and soft-locks Stadium, preventing player spawns; do not recommend as an active workflow.

<a id="wiki-7385-n2"></a>

- Historical workaround combined Clash/Control/Payload Race/Push modes and Return To Lobby: Never to expose Workshop settings; non-PC import code JK5440 was offered.

<a id="wiki-7385-n3"></a>

- Historical limitations: Stadium settings needed textual editing; Return To Lobby not Never ended after first round; updating settings midmatch could soft-lock next round; no Stadium-specific values/actions; normal variables/actions did not persist between rounds; only Unranked format; additional non-Stadium modes prevented starting.
